commit.message:
Remove unused upstream files and development notes

- Drop DrivoR's SimScale splits, scripts and data-loader branch, unused by World4Scorer.
- Drop unused baseline agents, broken helper scripts, the plotting tutorial and dead modules.
- Remove the Bench2Drive overlay-frame mode, an unused dataset class and CEM bookkeeping.
- Reword comments that recorded measurements or history; drop internal pack hashes.
- Restore NAVSIM v1.1 download scripts and loader; read navsim_logs for future targets.
- Update NOTICE accordingly.
